title: WIPO — GRATK treaty status (signatories and ratifications), status on July 8, 2026
version_note: WIPO's own treaty-status sheet, 'Status on July 8, 2026': 44 signatories, 4 accessions/ratifications (Albania, Malawi, Peru, Uganda). India is not in the signatory list. A dated snapshot: counts are true as of 2026-07-08 only, hence effective_from; re-fetch to update. Entry into force needs 15 ratifications (treaty page).
